title: Moving
wikitext:
'''Moving''' is a [[keyword]] used in various stats. It is the opposite of being [[stationary]]. [[Movement speed]] affects the rate at which you move without the assistance of active skills. '''Teleporting''' refers to moving instantly. 

==Mechanics==
A character is moving when its location is currently changing, and characters that stop moving become stationary instantly. Any change in location will reset any stats that track how long you have been moving or stationary, such as [[Soul of Tukohama]].<ref name="Movement_Skills_and_Stationary_Status" /> 

===Teleportation===
While changing position instantly by teleporting, an entity is considered to be stationary at every point in time.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1952961#p14733696</ref> However, it ''does'' cause the entity to move.<ref name="While_moving_effects_and_stationary_status" /><ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/bw184m/dumb_question_dont_upvote/epvtfjl/?context=5</ref> This gives teleporting the following interactions:  
* {{c|mod|while stationary}} stats apply at all times 
* {{c|mod|while moving}} stats apply at no point
* {{c|mod|if/when you move}} effects happen when you teleport
* {{c|mod|per second you've been stationary}} stats are reset

==Effects related to moving==
===Ailments===
* {{stl|Bleeding}}

===Passive skills===
====Notables====
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.is_notable = true
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%moving%"
}}

====Cluster Jewel Notables====
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.is_notable = true
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%moving%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

====Keystones====
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.is_keystone = true
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%moving%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}

====Masteries====
{{Query masteries}}

====Ascendancy====
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%moving%"
}}

===Pantheon===
{{Pantheon
|q_where=pantheon.id="Ralakesh"
}}

===Items===
====Uniques====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id like "%moving%"
|large=1
|stat=1
}}

====Affixes====
{{Modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  mods.stat_text LIKE "%moving%"
  AND mods.stat_text NOT LIKE "%removing%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0
  AND domain = 1
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
}}
